thread.title: Apple's stock drop would cut the Dow's price by about 22 points

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple's stock drop would cut the Dow's price by about 22 points
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) fell 1.9% in premarket trade Tuesday, and could be blamed for a chunk of the weakness in futures for the Dow Jones Industrial Average , in the aftermath of President Trump's comments about potential tariffs on iPhones (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-stock-falls-after-hours-as-trump-mentions-potential-tariffs-on-iphones-2018-11-26). The stock's price decline ahead of the open would shave about 22 points off the Dow's price, while Dow futures are down 57 points. Meanwhile, United Technologies Corp.'s stock (UTX) rose 1.1% in premarket trade after the industrial conglomerate said it will separate into three companies (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/united-tech-to-break-into-three-companies-spinning-off-otis-and-carrier-2018-11-26), which would add about 9 points to the Dow's price.
-Tomi Kilgore; 0731ET
